statement: No classes specialize in breeding; breeding level and XP are shared between all your classes so there are no stats to focus on.
Breeding has four sections: Breeding, Teams, Upgrade and Database.
Initially only the Green Spore is available; each pet shows its trait and the breeding chance to unlock the next pet.
Breeding chance is base chance times genetic multiplier and breedable multiplier (from Upgrades tab 3), giving a total chance.
Genetic multiplier is increased by spending DNA Splices on the Upgrade button.
You gain one egg every two hours; each Breed click spends one egg from the Egg Incubator and shows the pet you would get.
Combat pets have red background, foraging pets green, and breedable pets pink.
Pet storage slots are limited so be careful choosing which pets to keep; removing them later is annoying.
Trashing a pet gives gray DNA Splices which are used in the Upgrades tab.
Goal of the Breeding tab is simply to unlock more pets; each pet has a new trait.
Unlocking the Red Mushroom (gold key) unlocks all World 2 pets starting with Sandy Pot; you need more pets to unlock World 3 and onward.
You need a Splice Gun to get DNA Splices.
World 1 Splice Gun is bought from the World 4 shop and only enables splicing in World 1.
World 2 Splice Gun is crafted in Anvil tab 4 at the bottom with a recipe dropped by Pincermin; enables splicing up to World 2 mobs.
World 3 Splice Gun recipe drops from Thermisters in World 3 and enables splicing up to World 3.
Splice in a map of the same world as the pets you want: World 1 pets need World 1 splices and World 2 needs World 2.
Choose the map with your highest AFK gains for splicing; he has 56000 kills an hour.
Only way to get DNA Splices is to equip a Splice Gun and AFK in a map; claim via the Splice button on the AFK gains menu.
Clicking Splice re-rolls all your drops into Gene Splices except EXP per hour and coins.
Each genetic multiplier upgrade costs more splices so find a good balance on how much to spend.
Spending splices raised multiplier to 9 making chance go from 1 in 200 to 1 in 47; spending eggs also gains EXP.
Fenced Yard initially is only extra pet storage; its main function is levelling the Breedability multiplier with pink breedable pets.
Breedable multiplier gains apply only at daily reset so no instant gains but each day adds a little and makes new pets easier.
Green foraging pets placed in the foraging area add to total foraging speed based on their power; first area needs a pet battle.
Foraging speed divided by the green bar requirement gives resource fund per hour; each new foraging area gives the next level of Spices.
Claimed resource fund adds Spices to Cooking without using inventory slots; unlock foraging areas and forage pets as soon as possible for Cooking.
Pets need fight power to forage; the Jungle area needs a combat pet.
Jungle needs five fighting power to forage; later areas need more such as 100; you need a mix of foraging and fighting pets.
A later Breeding upgrade lets some foraging power count toward fighting power.
In fights select pets and drag them to the bottom; pets auto-attack each round, and abilities fill up and are activated by clicking.
Use abilities appropriately such as the foraging pet's heal; losing has no penalty so try different pet combinations.
Monsters attack your first pet first so put a beefy pet up front; use abilities as often as you can.
Pet Arena can only be fought once per day.
Do everything else before starting the Arena for the day.
Arena gives breeding bonuses that apply to nearly everything in the game; main purpose is gaining them; select pets like foraging fights.
Bonuses unlock by best round beaten; after round 12 the next four bonuses show.
Bonus tiers shown progress through rounds like 35 then 50 through 100 then 125 through 200.
Arena bonuses affect damage, new Post Office Boxes, Kitchen upgrades and money; the arena is continuous rounds until all pets are knocked out.
Initially only Genetic Splicing is available in Upgrades; it allows using your genetic multiplier.
Genetic Splicing costs gray DNA Splices plus a Kitchen recipe (Turkey); leveling it decreases DNA Splice cost for Gene Boosting.
At level 5 you unlock Egg Capacity raising max eggs in the Incubator; costs a lot of pies.
At level 10 you unlock Breedability Pulse; no pink pets until it is unlocked and levelled to 1; needs Corn.
Unlock Breedability Pulse as soon as possible even though it adds only a small percentage.
Upgrading it adds a bit more multiplier each day from breedable pets.
At level 15 you unlock Fence Extension which adds slots to the Fence Yard.
Beyond that new upgrades only benefit Breeding and speed things up with more bonuses and multipliers.
Database storage tab shows pets not actively foraging or in the Fence Yard.
Genetics tab shows discovered fighting genes; each genetic has a combat ability and a bonus; more pets unlock new genetics.
Combat abilities help damage or defense; bonuses range from combat to foraging; use them to build better teams for Pet Arenas.
Specials tab shows pets you have gained a Shiny version of.
Shiny chance is rare until higher levels where you can increase odds; each shiny gives a new bonus for foraging or combat.
